resources.string: See what each feature needs. Many work right away, without the full setup.

Device Owner lets KidGuard lock the home screen, hide apps, block uninstall and set DNS. It is set up once from a computer or a QR code (remove all accounts from the phone first). The guide has the steps.
The phone runs adb against itself over Wi-Fi. The guide shows how to turn on Wireless debugging.
Let bank apps reopen by themselves (display over other apps)
Turn off the KidGuard home screen
Pick KidGuard as the home app in the phone settings.
A simple home screen with widgets, folders and a \"Today\" page.
The child cannot switch to another home app.
Hide or disable system apps you do not need.
Daily and per-app limits, plus bedtime.
Block apps by list or by schedule.
See which apps were used and for how long.
Track the phone and safe zones.
Parents view the screen remotely (Android 11 and up).
The parent web page over Wi-Fi or the relay.
Block bad sites on the whole phone.
Needs a one-time permission granted from a computer (scripts/setup.sh, "pm grant"). It stays after Developer options are turned off.
Stops the child from turning location off.
